preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The dimensions of the grid are between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The elements of array B are distinct and between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N * M over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: Output N lines each containing M spaced integers
postconditions.description: The output must be a grid of size N x M with elements separated by spaces.
The output grid must minimize the score defined by the difference between the largest and smallest elements visited by the car.
